name: Clean Stylized Architectural Visualization
description: Technical clarity over photorealism; premium isometric architecture storytelling

LOCKED_THREE_QUARTER.note: Same view direction as the v0.1 camera (7.7, -9.9, 7.5) looking at (0, 0, 1.6); position and scale are fitted to geometry.

lighting.note: Sun lights so models anywhere are lit identically (SIDE_BY_SIDE). Key from front-left and high: front faces lit, right faces in shade, short shadows that do not reach a neighbouring model. Chosen 2026-10-26 from variants L0-L3 at 960x540.

materials.note: Highlight = self-coloured glow (no accent tint). Fading parts get blended-transparency twins shown only mid-fade; opaque frames use dithered materials.
